reportKinds.label: Performance risk

reportKinds.description: Signal coverage, trace boundaries and diagnostic readiness.

inputs.label: Application purpose & critical journeys
inputs.help: Who uses it, what must work, and which journeys affect the business.
inputs.suggestion: Identify critical user journeys and owners before selecting test scenarios.

inputs.label: Environment & architecture context
inputs.help: Environment parity, deployment topology, service dependencies and ownership. Do not enter credentials.
inputs.suggestion: Document environment differences and dependency owners; attach a repository map.

inputs.label: Workload & data assumptions
inputs.help: Peak concurrency or request rate, traffic mix, growth and representative data volumes.
inputs.suggestion: Collect production traffic distribution and representative data volumes to define a workload.

inputs.label: Service objectives & acceptance criteria
inputs.help: Latency percentiles, error budget, availability and business acceptance thresholds.
inputs.suggestion: Agree measurable pass/fail criteria with service owners; avoid arbitrary thresholds.

inputs.label: Metrics, logs & tracing coverage
inputs.help: Available dashboards, correlation IDs, dependency traces, sampling and alert ownership.
inputs.suggestion: Confirm metrics, structured logs and distributed traces can isolate a failing request before running load.

inputs.label: Recovery & failure controls
inputs.help: Timeouts, retries, idempotency, circuit breakers, RTO/RPO, blast radius, stop criteria and rollback.
inputs.suggestion: Define safe failure boundaries, abort conditions and recovery targets before chaos experiments.

inputs.label: Browser & accessibility requirements
inputs.help: Supported devices/browsers, critical journeys, accessibility target and manual assistive-technology coverage.
inputs.suggestion: Specify supported browsers, devices and accessibility target; include keyboard and screen-reader checks.

inputs.label: Existing evidence & incidents
inputs.help: Baseline observations, known incidents, sanitized tool summaries and evidence references.
inputs.suggestion: Attach a dated baseline or incident summary. Without observations, conclusions remain planning hypotheses.

inputs.label: Scope, safety & ownership
inputs.help: Authorized environment, excluded endpoints, maintenance window, data handling and responsible owners.
inputs.suggestion: Confirm scope, responsible owners and execution authorization before using external test tools.

investigations.title: Validate workload and latency budgets
investigations.question: Which journeys or dependencies could constrain throughput at peak traffic?
investigations.requiredEvidence: Representative traffic mix, data volumes, percentile objectives, per-route timings and resource saturation.
investigations.suggestion: Review expensive journeys and dependency fan-out with service owners; design a baseline before increasing load.

investigations.title: Check diagnostic coverage before execution
investigations.question: Can a slow or failed request be traced across service boundaries?
investigations.requiredEvidence: Correlation IDs, trace sampling, dependency spans, latency/error metrics, dashboards and alert ownership.
investigations.suggestion: Walk through one critical request and confirm each service emits enough signals to isolate its failure.

investigations.title: Review recovery and failure propagation
investigations.question: What happens when a dependency is unavailable or a request is repeated?
investigations.requiredEvidence: Timeout/retry policy, idempotency, failover assumptions, RTO/RPO, blast radius, rollback and abort conditions.
investigations.suggestion: Document expected failure behavior before designing an authorized, bounded chaos experiment.

investigations.title: Review critical journey experience
investigations.question: Which navigation, rendering or browser conditions can block the user journey?
investigations.requiredEvidence: Journey steps, supported browsers/devices, design acceptance criteria, screenshots and navigation/rendering observations.
investigations.suggestion: Prepare critical-journey checks and a consistent device profile; Lighthouse scores alone do not prove usability.

investigations.title: Plan automated and manual accessibility checks
investigations.question: Can keyboard and assistive-technology users complete the critical journey?
investigations.requiredEvidence: Accessibility target, focus order, labels, contrast, keyboard interactions and screen-reader observations.
investigations.suggestion: Combine axe findings with manual keyboard and screen-reader review; automated checks cannot certify conformance.
